# 技术翻译

这个技能可以把技术文档在中文和英文之间翻译，并保留代码块和术语。

## 安装

把 `translate-cn` 文件夹复制到 `~/.claude/skills/`。
files.translate-cn/SKILL.md:
---
name: translate-cn
description: Translates technical documents between Chinese and English and keeps code blocks and terms. Use when the user needs a translation of docs.
---

# Translate Cn

## Steps
1. Detect the source language.
2. Translate paragraphs.
3. Keep code as is.
